entries.title: Controller Support, Gameplay Tweaks & Visual Improvements
body: Headline Feature:
- Added keyboard and controller support for easier menu navigation
Quality of Life:
- Moved the location of the Grump Rock Cooler
- Decreased Spear Guard health
- Changed the elevator logic so that it starts when the player is on it
Visual Consistency Fixes:
- Added more corner tiles that were missed on the map
- Changed the size of buttons in the Main Menu
- Revamped the look of the starting area
Bug Fix:
- Fixed a bug which caused the game to crash when switching tabs

entries.title: Small Adjustments and Fixes
body: - Fixed the version text displaying the incorrect version number
- The UI for a cooler was incorrectly aligned causing the UI to go off screen
- Fixed the position of a cooler

entries.title: Small Adjustments and Fixes
body: - Changed the colour and anchor of the version text
- Slightly adjusted the position of the tutorial text due to it overlapping with some of the UI elements

entries.title: Small Adjustments and Fixes
body: - Fixed misalignment issues with the Chest and Cooler UI
- Slightly adjusted the color and position of the Boulder Key Gate
- Improved the visual presentation of tutorial prompts
- Adjusted the position of the version number text
- Corrected the formatting of the Best Time display
- Made minor layout improvements to the Options menu

entries.title: Hotfix
body: - The player was set to the wrong spawn and has been fixed
- Added a version number text in main menu
- Slightly updated the format of the timer

entries.title: Gameplay Improvements & Arena Update
body: - Reworked the "Grump Rock" Arena with layout improvements and gameplay adjustments
- Added a Speedrun Timer toggle in the Options menu
- The game now tracks total player deaths and displays them on the end screen
- Moved a Cooler inside the "Grump Rock" arena to improve respawn flow
- Rebalanced Crystal Crawlers (reduced health and fixed respawn delay)
- Adjusted Spear Guard knockback distance
- Added an additional Patrolling Shroom enemy
- Fixed a bug where standing below gold could push the player into the tilemap
- Adjusted bounce height for one of the mushrooms
- Updated an overlooked area with additional sprites and tiles for improved visuals

entries.title: Adjustments and Fixes
body: - Gump Rock now has increased health and improved movement speed
- Time Dialled state should now work reliably
- Adjusted background colors to feel more distant and less visually distracting
- Rebalanced Spear Guard health
- Fixed a bounce mushroom that was slightly misaligned
- Added back the missing fade in the main menu

entries.title: Hotfix
body: - Fixed an issue that caused the main menu title to look weird
- Gold can now be picked up correctly after death
- The size of the trigger for the cavern safe point has been increased

entries.title: Hotfix
body: - Fixed fullscreen handling to reduce brief taskbar/desktop flashes during gameplay
- Adjusted the knockback of the Spear Gaurd
- Bosses now stay in the stunned state for a bit longer when parried
- Cursor now hides on game start and shows when the pause menu opens

body: - Fixed some missing corner tiles in the environment

entries.title: Hotfix
body: - Synced main menu and pause menu settings across scenes
- Fixed pause menu button input not working after changes in display settings

entries.title: Update
body: - Completed Crystal Caverns
- Added new enemies and bosses
- Introduced new player mechanics
- Implemented a main menu and pause menu
- Fixed bugs and improved performance
